dominant_breach: wage garnishment, bank levy, and judgment execution against the recovery floor

fresh_start_capacity_gate.note: Fresh start fails if paycheck or bank-account seizures remove rent, food, transport, utilities, or work tools after judgment.

wage_garnishment_protection.note: Federal CCPA limits and job-protection rules exist, but adequacy depends on state floors, disposable earnings, household size, and whether income volatility/gig income is covered.

bank_account_levy_protection.note: Bank-account protection is a threshold issue because funds can be frozen or seized before a debtor can assert exemptions; self-executing safe deposits matter more than paper rights.

exemption_self_execution.note: Self-executing protection is required; otherwise the remedy arrives after rent, utility, or account-access failure.

judgment_lien_and_property_seizure.note: Property and vehicle seizure rules must be scored against work access and modest home/vehicle equity rather than aggregate statutory descriptions.

protected_recovery_floor.note: The case demands a protected recovery floor covering wages, bank accounts, benefits, vehicles, tools, and minimum household liquidity.

proof_debt: state-by-state protected recovery floor after judgment
time between levy/garnishment notice and fund release
coverage of gig, contract, irregular, and benefit income
repeat judgment renewal and interest tail

gate_18_fresh_start_capacity.why: Comfort certification is blocked until the scoreboard proves claim conversion, notice, timing, legal aid or administrative capacity, vendor/report suppression where relevant, and subgroup outcomes at the actual threshold moment.

evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Build a state table for wage, bank-account, vehicle, homestead, tool, benefit, and household-goods protection, with self-execution status.

evidence_debt_register.question: time between levy/garnishment notice and fund release
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Collect court, bank, employer, and regulator evidence on how long exempt funds remain frozen.

evidence_debt_register.question: coverage of gig, contract, irregular, and benefit income
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Score whether CCPA/state protections cover nonpayroll earnings and direct-deposit benefits without debtor litigation.

evidence_debt_register.question: repeat judgment renewal and interest tail
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Pair with default-judgment case to score interest, renewal, lien, and reporting tails after the original collection event.

remedy_operability_register.claimant_perimeter: Judgment debtors and households with protected wages, benefits, or bank deposits
remedy_operability_register.standing_path: Exemption claim, court motion, bank/employer release process, AG or regulator complaint
remedy_operability_register.notice_explanation: Notice must identify protected funds and plain-language exemption process before freeze/turnover
remedy_operability_register.interim_protection: Automatic protection or immediate holdback of subsistence funds
remedy_operability_register.time_to_relief: Hours to days, not weeks, for rent, food, utilities, transport, and medicine
remedy_operability_register.review_body: State court, bank/employer process, attorney general, labor department, or consumer regulator
remedy_operability_register.collective_or_representative_action: Legal aid, attorney-general enforcement, pattern-practice challenges, and court rule reform
remedy_operability_register.restoration_remedy: Release of funds, quashing/reducing garnishment, sanctions, fee shifting, and correction of judgment records
remedy_operability_register.enforcement_actor: State courts, banks, employers, attorneys general, DOL/consumer regulators
